name: v28_option_pcr_volume_term_structure
hypothesis: A steep short-term versus medium-term put/call volume ratio can indicate transient option-flow demand; the term-structure spread should be less crowded than breakeven or skew.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_vol_10 - pcr_vol_180, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_vol_all, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 90), industry)
notes: Tests option volume term structure, not breakeven/skew. Short-interest term is a small stabilizer only.

name: v28_option_pcr_oi_curve_compression
hypothesis: Open-interest positioning that is flatter from short to longer tenors may reflect less crowded downside demand and better forward risk appetite.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(pcr_oi_10 - pcr_oi_180), 90), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_oi_all, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 60), industry)
notes: Uses PCR OI curve shape rather than single-tenor positive/reversal signal; risk term avoids quality/reversal parents.

name: v28_short_pressure_product_news
hypothesis: High short interest combined with improving product-news sentiment can create delayed covering pressure after product/service news.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_product, 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(news_short_interest, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(nws12_mainz_volstddev, 60), industry)
notes: Revisits short interest only under an event/product-news catalyst; no operating quality anchor.

name: v28_short_interest_option_flow_confirm
hypothesis: Short interest confirmed by put/call volume and open interest can capture persistent informed bearish positioning rather than simple short squeeze reversal.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(news_short_interest, 90), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_vol_60, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pcr_oi_60 - pcr_oi_10, 90), industry)
notes: Tests informed bearish positioning sign; strict corr gate will catch overlap with option actives.

name: v28_social_attention_positive_regime
hypothesis: Rising social attention is more useful when sentiment is positive; combining attention and value should avoid pure noisy-buzz exposure.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_volume, 45), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value, 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(snt_social_value, 20), 60), industry)
notes: Different from old sentiment-stability single factor: attention and sentiment must align.

name: v28_social_buzz_reversal_with_calm
hypothesis: Negative change in relative buzz after a high-attention episode may mark fading attention; calm sentiment volatility may make the reversal cleaner.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_buzz_ret, 45), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(scl12_sentiment, 20), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(scl12_buzz, 45), industry)
notes: Uses social attention regime only, no earnings/reversal/quality parent.

name: v28_news_session_pressure_residual
hypothesis: Session-level news pressure with unusual volume/range can capture event underreaction distinct from aggregated earnings news.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(nws12_mainz_sl, 30), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(nws12_mainz_volstddev, 45), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(nws12_mainz_rangestddev), 45), industry)
notes: Uses news12 session fields rather than rp_nip_earnings or close/open.

name: v28_news_vwap_acceptance
hypothesis: When post-news VWAP and market-relative performance are strong together, the market may be accepting news rather than temporarily overreacting.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(news_indx_perf, 45), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank((news_eod_vwap - news_main_vwap) / close, 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(nws12_mainz_volstddev, 45), industry)
notes: Revisits event-relative performance with a VWAP acceptance companion after pure news_indx_perf failed.

name: v28_dividend_guidance_short_pressure
hypothesis: Positive dividend guidance spread under elevated short interest can signal shareholder-return commitment that shorts may underprice.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((dividend_max_guidance_value - dividend_min_guidance_value) / close, 90), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * news_short_interest, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(dividend, 126), industry)
notes: Tests payout guidance without buyback/dilution parent; dividend level only small stabilizer.

name: v28_financing_guidance_risk_relief
hypothesis: Improving financing-cash-flow guidance combined with lower idiosyncratic risk can identify balance-sheet relief without using credit-facility fields.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(cash_flow_financing_max_guidance / assets, 90), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: Avoids credit_facility_* after v27; risk relief should be mechanistically different from accounting pressure.
